decisions.notes: Direct dependency with exact version in package.json; lockfile lists only this instance. Highest scanner-listed solution is 4.18.0 (CVE-2026-4800); advisory text cites 4.18.1—use 4.18.1 to satisfy 4.17.21, 4.17.23, and template-import fixes in one step. No overrides or version catalog; bump lodash and run npm install to refresh package-lock.json. Repo use is basic utilities in tests, not _.template or path-based unset/omit with untrusted input, so a 4.17.x→4.18.x bump is low risk here.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-logging` on every starter. Conditional-config ACE needs Janino plus writable config or env injection; low practical risk for this app. Set `logback.version` / upgrade Boot BOM like existing Tomcat overrides.

Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-json`, actuator, and test starters. Petclinic uses classic servlet MVC (not WebFlux), so async-parser DoS paths are less exposed but JSON parsing is still on the hot path. Align with `jackson-bom.version` property or Boot upgrade; 2.21.7 is the minimum on the 21 line but 2.22.3 satisfies every listed fix.

Same BOM-managed transitives as jackson-core; must stay version-aligned with jackson-core. PTV/default typing issues matter only if polymorphic typing is enabled (not typical here). Upgrade Boot or Jackson BOM property; keep databind and core on the same release.

Transitive through `spring-boot-starter-actuator` (direct starter). Actuator is on the runtime classpath in Gradle; HTTP/gRPC metric parsing DoS is relevant when endpoints are exposed. Fix via Boot 3.5.12+ or micrometer version property on the 1.15 line.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `log4j-to-slf4j` bridge; logging backend is Logback. Issue affects MapMessage JSON layouts only—unlikely unless JsonTemplateLayout with attacker-controlled map values is used. Bump `log4j2.version` or Boot BOM.

Declared `runtimeOnly` in Gradle and runtime in Maven without an explicit version (parent/BOM managed today). Used only under the `postgres` profile; channel-binding and SCRAM issues matter for production PostgreSQL deployments. Set `postgresql.version` in properties or rely on newer Boot parent—same override style as Tomcat.

Version follows Boot plugin (Gradle) and parent POM (Maven); jar is transitive via starters/devtools. `ApplicationTemp` / persistent session issue needs local same-host attacker and `server.servlet.session.persistent=true` (not default). Raise `spring-boot` plugin and parent together to ≥3.5.15.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via all starters. Embedded Artemis predictable data directory is irrelevant unless embedded Artemis auto-config runs (not used in Petclinic). Fixed on the 3.5 line at 3.5.15 via Boot version bump.

Explicit dependency in both builds (Gradle runtimeOnly). Health-group / Cloud Foundry path auth-bypass CVEs apply when Actuator is enabled and paths overlap custom secured endpoints—review `management.*` config after upgrade to ≥3.5.12.

Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`. DoS via property paths, sort parsing, and `@ProjectedPayload` affects apps exposing Spring Data web binding; Petclinic uses repository APIs with typical MVC controllers—moderate exposure if sort/page params are attacker-controlled. Upgrade Boot to ≥3.5.12.

BOM-managed via Boot. Annotation resolution bug on generic hierarchies affects `@EnableMethodSecurity` on generic supertypes; Petclinic does not declare method security. Still upgrade Framework with Boot release that manages ≥6.2.11.
Transitive via web stack. SpEL DoS requires evaluating attacker-supplied expressions; typical Petclinic code does not expose SpEL. Fix at 6.2.19 through Boot BOM bump.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-web`. RFD via non-ASCII Content-Disposition filenames and SSRF via UriComponentsBuilder require specific application patterns; review any download endpoints. 6.2.19 addresses both on the 6.2 line.

decisions.reason: no safe version bump is available
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-web`. Advisories list 7.0.9 as the fix for CRITICAL XsltView RCE and SSE corruption while 6.2.0–6.2.19 remain affected; other listed CVEs clear at 6.2.19 on Boot 3.x. Boot 3.5.15 cannot ship Framework 7 without a major migration (Boot 4). Petclinic does not reference XsltView, which lowers practical RCE risk. Partial mitigation: Boot upgrade to latest 3.5.x for non-CRITICAL items; full CRITICAL clearance may require Spring Boot 4 / Framework 7 or a future 6.2.x backport not listed in scanner solutions.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct require in go-gin/go.mod; app uses the standard Go driver with URI/username-password auth in configs/setup.go, so the GSSAPI/Kerberos heap OOB read is unlikely unless production enables Kerberos auth. A 1.11→1.17 driver bump is still the repo’s normal go.mod + go.sum workflow; run integration tests against MongoDB for BSON/API behavior changes.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect module version pinned in go.mod; pulled by gin, validator, mongo-driver, and cors at lower declared mins, with MVS selecting v0.55.0. CVEs target golang.org/x/crypto/ssh DoS paths—the Gin HTTP API does not appear to use ssh, but upgrading via `go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.56.0` is low-risk and matches existing go.mod management.

Indirect require in go.mod; consumed by Gin and other HTTP-related dependencies. Fixes span golang.org/x/net/html and http2 (DoS, smuggling, XSS in HTML rendering)—relevant to any HTTP/2 or HTML parsing on the server. `go get golang.org/x/net@v0.62.0` satisfies the highest advisory floor (0.62.0 for html issues; also covers 0.60.0 http2 fixes); go mod may co-upgrade x/crypto/x/text.

Lockfile transitive: required by direct dependency axios (^1.16.0) and devDependency http-proxy via webpack-dev-server. axios’s semver range already allows 1.16.2; refresh package-lock.json with npm update/install—no package.json override field exists today. Browser axios bundles typically do not use this Node helper; risk is mainly Node-side redirects with custom sensitiveHeaders.

Lockfile transitive bundled under postcss@8.4.19 (^3.3.4 range permits 3.3.18 without jumping to nanoid 5.x). Used at build time by the Vue CLI CSS pipeline, not declared in package.json. Staying on major 3 avoids a breaking jump to 5.x; lockfile refresh after postcss bump or targeted resolution should suffice unless a parent pins exactly 3.3.4.

Lockfile transitive from @vue/cli-service (~5.0) and related webpack/css tooling; package.json has no direct postcss entry. @vue/cli-service declares postcss ^8.4.14, which accepts 8.5.23. A separate nested postcss@7.0.39 remains under @vue/component-compiler-utils and is outside this 8.4.19 finding—may need a tooling upgrade to retire 7.x. CVEs mostly affect parsing untrusted CSS (source maps, XSS in stringify)—primarily dev/build unless untrusted CSS is processed at runtime.

Lockfile transitive dependency of postcss@8.4.19 (^1.0.2). DoS via malformed indexed source maps affects build-time source-map handling. Typically co-resolves when postcss is upgraded and package-lock.json is refreshed; no separate direct dep or npm override in the repo today.
